reason: I already carry a bottle and refill at the office fountain, which is filtered and free, so I've already stopped buying bottled water. A $68 bottle plus a filter subscription solves a problem I don't really have, and a plastic filter cartridge shipped from overseas every couple of months doesn't feel any greener to me.
objection: The fountain water I drink is already fine, and 5-8 working days from overseas plus disposable plastic filters on a subscription doesn't fit why I went reusable in the first place.
would_change_my_mind: Proof the filter cartridges are recyclable or taken back, plus independent test results showing it removes something my tap or fountain water actually has in it.
